title: Trading Streak Report
brief: A trading desk records the daily profit or loss of a strategy as signed integers. The quarterly report highlights the best streak: the run of consecutive trading days with the largest combined result.
Implement bestProfitStreak(nums), where nums holds the daily results in date order, and return the combined result of that best streak.
